tone.target: warm mid-gain French pop-rock with chorus sheen
tone.profile: warm mid-gain French pop-rock with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A clean foundation built around the US Deluxe or UK 45, enhanced by a Chorus effect for sheen, followed by a modest Overdrive boost to achieve the required mid-gain crunch. The tone is kept warm and round.
corrections: favor warm mids over generic rock crunch

rig.name: Daniel Balavoine - Mon Fils Ma Bataille - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
